citationText: 11. We offer no opinion on the 59.94/60.00 question. It would be better to choose only one. and we would choose 60. If broadcasters absolutely insist on 59.94. which we think is a mistake, then it might be better to abandon 60. Likewise, although we believe that equal horizontal and vertical resolution (“square pixels”) is very desirable, there is sentiment on the part of some progressive-scan advocates for reducing the horizontal resolution somewhat in order to reduce the overall data rate. This would be a much smaller departure from the ideal than to allow interlace. It should be allowed.
